create_NearestCentroid: create a NearestCentroid classifier with optional shrink_threshold for regularized centroid computation
fit_NearestCentroid: fit a NearestCentroid classifier on training data X and labels y
predict_NearestCentroid: predict class labels for input samples using a fitted NearestCentroid classifier
plot_DecisionBoundaryDisplay: plot decision boundaries for a fitted classifier using DecisionBoundaryDisplay.from_estimator
load_iris_dataset: load the iris dataset and extract the first two features for 2D visualization
